data.name: Divija
data.gender_notes: Divija is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Divija is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning 'Divine Goddess' or 'Shining One'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'diva', meaning 'heavenly' or 'divine'. This name is often given to girls born during auspicious occasions, as it is believed to bring blessings and good fortune. The name Divija carries the meaning “Divine Goddess, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Divija usually hope their child will grow to embody divine goddess, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divija represents the divine feminine and the divine light within each of us. It is a reminder to shine our light brightly and to trust in the divine guidance and protection.
data.etymology: Divija belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine Goddess, Shining One.”

Hinduism places a significant emphasis on the worship of goddesses, who are seen as nurturing, powerful, and happy givers. The name embodies the belief in the superiority and power of femininity, often associated with guides, protectors, and nourishers.

It reflects the belief that the divine lies within, and that through self-realization and connection with our inner goddess, we can tap into the limitless power and strength that resides within us. Its spiritual significance invites us to honor the divine feminine, manifesting as courage, love, wisdom, and creative abundance.
